findings.title: One-way uncapped vendor indemnity
findings.impact: The vendor assumes unlimited indemnification liabilities without mutuality or limitation.

citations.docTitle: Monsoon Data Studio vendor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: The Vendor shall indemnify AtliQ against all losses, claims, damages and expenses arising from the Services or any act or omission of the Vendor or its personnel

findings.standard: Mutual: each party covers its own breach and negligence; never the other side's negligence. IP-infringement indemnity for deliverables is normal.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own conflict or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).

findings.title: One-sided limitation of liability
findings.impact: The vendor is exposed to unlimited liability while AtliQ's liability is strictly limited.

citations.docTitle: Monsoon Data Studio vendor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: AtliQ's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding one (1) month. (No limit is stated for the Vendor

findings.standard: Each party's aggregate liability capped at 1× fees (paid or payable in the prior 12 months), mutual; carve-outs only for fraud, wilful misconduct and confidentiality (plus any carve-outs that are mandatory under the governing law, e.g. German law for intent/gross negligence and injury).
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and non-compliance with confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).

findings.title: One-sided termination for convenience
findings.impact: The vendor lacks reciprocal convenience termination rights.

citations.docTitle: Monsoon Data Studio vendor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: AtliQ may terminate at any time on seven (7) days' notice. The Vendor may terminate only for AtliQ's uncured non-payment

findings.standard: On any termination for convenience AtliQ is paid for all work done, including work in progress. Notice is mutual. Client contracts: reasonable notice (typically 30+ days). Freelancer / vendor agreements: a mutual short exit (about 15 days, as with Rohan Iyer) is AtliQ's standard and fair to both sides.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.

precedents.label: standard
precedents.note: Mutual 15-day exit

findings.title: Unilateral indefinite confidentiality obligation
findings.impact: The vendor is subject to perpetual, non-mutual confidentiality obligations.

citations.docTitle: Monsoon Data Studio vendor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: The Vendor shall keep confidential all information of AtliQ and its clients indefinitely

findings.standard: Mutual in substance, not just in title: both parties' information protected, both bound by the same obligations, residuals mutual or none, mutual remedies, fixed term, and no non-competes or non-solicits hidden inside an NDA.
findings.counterPosition: Make the definitions and obligations mutual, delete residuals (or make them mutual), delete restrictive covenants, mutual remedies (injunction may be sought by either party), fixed 2–3 year term.

findings.title: Vesting of vendor pre-existing materials
findings.impact: The vendor loses ownership of its pre-existing tools and materials incorporated into the deliverables.

citations.docTitle: Monsoon Data Studio vendor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: All work product, and any pre-existing materials of the Vendor incorporated into it, shall vest in AtliQ on creation

findings.standard: Every freelancer / vendor assigns the work product to AtliQ (from creation or at least on payment) so AtliQ can give clients what it promises; their pre-existing tools are licensed broadly enough for the client deal.
findings.counterPosition: Contractor assigns all rights in the work product to AtliQ; pre-existing materials are licensed on terms that let AtliQ pass to the client what the client contract requires.
